data.description: Follow-up to the MCP cross-session warning story (734d). That story added the `cross_session_warning` field only to responses that return `WriteAckOut` or `TicketStateOut`. Four single-ticket mutation tools return a different contract and were deferred: `transition_ticket` and `reopen_ticket` (raw engine dict), `check_ac` (`GateResultOut`), and `declare_no_file_impact` (bare `str`). Extend the cross-session warning to these by threading the advisory into their respective return shapes (an additive `cross_session_warning` key on the dict returns; a new optional field on `GateResultOut`; a shape change for declare_no_file_impact). The CLI surface already warns on these verbs, so this closes the MCP structured-response parity gap.
data.title: MCP: carry cross_session_warning in dict/GateResult-returning single-ticket tools
